title: 我的朋友
summary: Meet Xiaoming, who loves tea and Taiwanese food.
paragraphs: 這是我的朋友小明。他是臺灣人。
小明二十歲。他很高，也很好看。
他喜歡喝茶，不喜歡喝咖啡。
我們常常一起吃晚飯。小明說：「臺灣的東西很好吃！」
translation: This is my friend Xiaoming. He is Taiwanese.
Xiaoming is twenty. He is tall and good-looking.
He likes drinking tea, not coffee.
We often have dinner together. Xiaoming says, "Taiwanese food is delicious!"
